metadata.notes: twapOrder is an L1 action (phantom-agent scheme), signed exactly like `order` — the wrapper dispatches it to the agent tier. Distinct action type from `order`: the payload is `{type, twap: {a, b, s, r, m, t}}`, not `{type, orders, grouping}`. msgpack is the exact preimage keccak-hashed (with nonce/vaultAddress/expiresAfter appended as raw bytes, per action_hash()) to build the phantom-agent EIP-712 message that source/connectionId wraps. `m` is TWAP duration in minutes (5-1440); `t` enables randomized child-order timing.
